small_test_set.problem: Only 30 test samples, 10 intents = ~3 samples per intent
small_test_set.evidence: Some intents have 0 test samples (refund_return, technical_device, resolution_confirmation)

class_imbalance.problem: Test set not balanced across intents
class_imbalance.impact: Accuracy dominated by majority classes (non_english, escalation_needed)

golden_set_quality.problem: Single annotator, no inter-annotator agreement measured
golden_set_quality.impact: Labels may be inconsistent or wrong
golden_set_quality.evidence: Cohen's Kappa not computed in Phase 2.2

auto_handle_threshold.impact: Prime query (0.67 confidence) escalated despite correct intent
auto_handle_threshold.evidence: Threshold trades off precision/recall without business justification

retrieval_vs_generation.problem: Only intent accuracy measured, not response quality
retrieval_vs_generation.impact: Good retrieval ≠ good response; template responses not evaluated
retrieval_vs_generation.evidence: No human evaluation of generated responses

data_leakage_risk.problem: Split at conversation level but similar queries across conversations
data_leakage_risk.impact: Near-duplicate customer queries may appear in both train and test
data_leakage_risk.evidence: Many 'package delivered but not received' variants in dataset

intent_taxonomy_issues.problem: Billing vs Account merged but have different language; Prime vs Technical merged
intent_taxonomy_issues.impact: Systematic confusion between billing_payment and account_access
intent_taxonomy_issues.evidence: 7 billing queries, 43% accuracy; 4 account queries, 75% accuracy

resolution_heuristic.problem: Heuristic (resolution keywords OR ≥3 messages) ≠ actual resolution
resolution_heuristic.impact: Many 'resolved' conversations may not be truly resolved
resolution_heuristic.evidence: Only keyword matching, no outcome verification
